node.title: C36' weighted Mobius rich-fiber excess is at most n^2/2
node.statement: For every official row, with A=(1-H)\{0}, P(t)=#{(a,b) in A^2:ab=t}, R(t)=#{(c,d) in A^2:d/c=t}, and X_18=sum_{t!=1}max(P(t)-18,0)R(t), one has 17X_18<=300n^2. This cutoff-18 target is strictly weaker than the former X_35<=n^2/2 premise. The proved non-swap compiler shows that S_ns<=1200n^2 is sufficient, replacing the prior 68n^2 target. FALSIFIER: one exact official row with 17X_18>300n^2. [IMPORT PINS r2 (2026-07-12 wave-2; supersedes the r1 pins block): FULL CORRIDOR — every official row n = 2^s, 13 <= s <= 41, every prime p = 1 mod n, p >= n^2. The cutoff-18 weakening (17 X_18 <= 300n^2) verified exactly at import: 68 sharp (1088 = 34*32, 1224 = 36*34), cutoff-35 => cutoff-18 strict, and the C36' close re-lands with rational margin 48/425 > 0 at n >= 8192 — the banked cutoff-35 ledger and M35 survive as strictly stronger background routes. Q-SURV TRANSFERS to the weakened form: the banked 12-prime sweep's max overlap P <= 20 gives (P-18)+ <= 2, so 17 X_18 <= 34 (n-1)(n-2) < 300n^2 with 9x room at every swept row; the 7,090-row sweep and both n=8192 replays stand. Open range n^2 <= p <= 6^{n/4} preserved; full pose bodies in the node folders (w10-C8 node-id collision hazard recorded). || H3 LOW-DISTANCE ROUTER (wave-12 audited, 2026-07-18; dependency-clean, req-ancestry = the wave-6 rich-fiber cutoff + sidon only): at fixed order, every cutoff-18 rich prime divides a member of the finite low-distance collision-norm set; primes outside it have X_18 = Y_18 = 0. Open range unchanged; the router proves its own infeasibility fence (>= 530,590,075 orbits at n = 8192); the Modal pilot is EXPERIMENTAL route evidence with a negative dedup decision (22.98x -> 1.95x), no theorem promotion. || WAVE-13 (2026-07-19, audited): the H3 ideal-stars routing + the 15-node suite reduce the red to ONE analytic estimate — the E=6 disjoint-support moment; even-distance parity lemma: collision distances between rich-prime template members are even (one line, banked). Open range n^2 <= p <= 6^{n/4} unchanged. || WAVE-14 (2026-07-19, audited; dated per #285): the E=6 residual is EXACTLY reformulated as the integer correlation 10 J_25^0 + 17 J_25^A <= 892 n^2 (J = 8D exact) between disjoint split-pencil members Q_(t,r)(X) = X^2-(1+r-t)X+r and the affine line fiber (pin: (X-r)Q_(t,s)-(X-s)Q_(t,r) = t(s-r)X); the fixed-order route gains the coupled-ideal sieve (positive Y_18 forces p | Norm(alpha_F, alpha_G, theta, lambda) <= 6^(n/4)/4; zero-coupling locus exactly {x,y,z}={q,-q,-q^2}, w=q^4). EXACT RESIDUAL: the DSP8 correlation bound + the official-order template generator (CR-001 updated; CR-002-L banked same-commit per #286). || AMBER (2026-07-19, maintainer-directed ceremony): CONDITIONAL gate=any on two ALT leaves — f3_h3_dsp8_correlation_bound (the analytic route; EXACTLY the E=6 residual, wave-14 equivalence) OR f3_h3_official_order_template_survivor (the fixed-order route via the coupled-ideal sieve). Either leaf closing closes this red. DSP8 F-round 1 pre-registered and queued (the C1' lesson: fresh leaves get rounds before weight rests on them). conditional.md is the assembly of record. node.attack_surface: The proved rich-fiber norm cutoff closes p>6^(n/4). On the remaining range n^2<=p<=6^(n/4), prove a truncated product/quotient correlation estimate, not a global shifted-energy bound. Candidate routes: constants-explicit rich-level incidence tails paired with quotient weights; an oriented character/Jacobi estimate retaining phases; or classification of only the simultaneous rich-product/rich-quotient locus. The background pointwise M35 cap is sufficient but deliberately stronger and is not the critical claim. [WAVE-13 ADDENDUM (2026-07-19; the pin rewrote this field in place — master framing preserved, new content appended per #104): The proved rich-fiber norm cutoff closes p>6^(n/4). On the remaining range n^2<=p<=6^(n/4), the preferred direct target is the E=6 disjoint-support moment D_6,25^0+(17/10)D_6,25^A<=(223/20)n^2; do not restore the already-paid overlap strata. The fixed-order alternative remains the E=14 degree-twelve candidate-prime certificate. Broader alternatives are a constants-explicit rich-level correlation estimate, an oriented character/Jacobi estimate retaining phases, or classification of only the simultaneous rich-product/rich-quotient locus. The background pointwise M35 cap is sufficient but deliberately stronger and is not the critical claim.] [WAVE-14 ADDENDUM (2026-07-19; second in-place rewrite refused per #104/#284 — master field preserved): The proved rich-fiber norm cutoff closes p>6^(n/4). On the remaining range n^2<=p<=6^(n/4), the preferred direct target is the E=6 disjoint-support moment D_6,25^0+(17/10)D_6,25^A<=(223/20)n^2; do not restore the already-paid overlap strata. Fixed-order alternatives are the E=14 degree-twelve candidate-prime certificate and the proved double-accident nonzero-coupling gate. For a selected product-star center, at most one quotient lift has zero coupling, so a target of multiplicity R(t)>=2 supplies at least R(t)-1 nonzero generators in one row-prime ideal. Coarse templates need only the three-generator ideal (alpha_F,alpha_G,lambda). At exact survivors, the odd-saturation syzygies make both product- and quotient-collision generator types redundant: one coupling row and column generate the full product-by-quotient rectangle at every official row prime. Its nonzero-entry count is not an ideal-index bound. Every prime outside this finite candidate set has Y_18=0. Broader alternatives are a constants-explicit rich-level correlation estimate, an oriented character/Jacobi estimate retaining phases, or classification of only the simultaneous rich-product/rich-quotient locus. The background pointwise M35 cap is sufficient but deliberately stronger and is not the critical claim.]
